messages.subject: DartR package not loading
parts:
Hello, 

I've just updated my dartR to version 2, and now I cannot get it to load in in Rstudio at all. I've tried updating R, uninstalling and reinstalling the package and it's still not working. I even tried running it in administrator mode with no luck. 

Does anybody have any ideas on how I can get it running?

Thanks, 
Patricia

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: DartR package not loading
parts:
Hi Patricia,

Could you please provide more information so that we can help you more efficiently.

Can you try first:

1. Restarting your computer.

2. Updating your packages:

> update.packages(ask = F)

3. Updating R, R-studio, which is sometimes a bit troublesome but here is a nice tutorial:

 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/3-methods-update-r-rstudio-windows-mac-woratana-ngarmtrakulchol 

If you are still having problems installing dartR, can you:

1. Tell us what's the error that appears in your R console when you try to load dartR.

2. Send information about your R-session using the command:

> sessionInfo()

 

Cheers,

Luis
